topic: Same tiny part, two opposite problems: engine overheats, or never warms up (thermostat)
negativePromptStanding: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Two totally different problems — same tiny part.
beats.visualPrompt: Split-screen composition: left half a dashboard temperature gauge needle pinned toward 'H,' right half the same gauge style needle sitting cold near 'C,' both dimly lit interiors, static-mounted camera.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two ~2s sub-shots (hot side, cold side) before real generation.

beats.narration: Temp gauge climbs fast. Engine overheats within minutes of driving.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a dashboard temperature gauge needle climbing steadily into the red zone; cut to a wisp of steam rising from under a hood in a parking lot, warm daylight.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots (gauge climb, steam) before real generation.

beats.narration: Or the opposite — heater stays lukewarm, gauge barely moves, gas mileage drops.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on an HVAC vent with visibly cool/lukewarm air movement (subtle fabric ribbon flutter, no visible breath fog), then cut to a dashboard trip-computer MPG readout ticking down.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots (vent, MPG readout) before real generation.

beats.narration: One clue: the thermostat. Stuck closed traps the heat. Stuck open lets it escape.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro cutaway shot: a thermostat housing removed from an engine, the thermostat valve visible either fully closed (stuck-shut framing) or fully open (stuck-open framing), resting on a clean workbench, slow push-in.

beats.narration: Don't just top off coolant and hope — the part itself may need replacing.
beats.visualPrompt: A coolant reservoir being topped off, then a slow pull-back revealing the thermostat housing still sitting disassembled on the bench nearby.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots (top-off, pull-back reveal) before real generation.

beats.narration: Worth checking before it strands you or wastes gas. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold.
